# 1.0.9 beta 5

This beta supersedes 1.0.9 beta 4 and hardens the Titanfall page transitions and keyboard navigation.

- Make the Titanfall open/close animation interruptible and reversible: backing out or choosing the
  game again mid-transition now settles on the requested destination instead of dropping the input.
- Make Escape and Backspace return from Titanfall to game selection from every tab, including
  Overview, with focus restored to the Titanfall card. Backspace still edits text fields and does
  not bypass open overlays.
- Move the whole Titanfall page surface through one transition, keeping navigation, tabs, content
  and accessibility state together.
- Add deterministic headless screenshots at the open/close transition midpoint for full and reduced
  motion with English and long German layouts, plus the required CI font dependencies.
- Refresh the README screenshots, current download links and status summary.

Automated coverage is now 190 tests (165 Core + 25 headless UI).

The installer archive remains self-contained, checksum-verified and installable without root.
